title: Dating Buddy Petit's death by Louis Armstrong's visits
summary: Interviewer and Lewis try to pin down the year, linking it to Louis Armstrong's visits in 1931 and to Chris Kelly's funeral.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
